description:
What does the Bible teach about rings? Learn the answer to this question and many more on this episode of 3ABN Today Bible Q & A.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.     What does the Bible teach about rings? Specifically rings for the finger or the one which is commonly used to differentiate between married and unmarried groups. 

2.     During creation, was it implied that Sabbath should be observed, or was it written somewhere, during that time? If implied, does 1 Cor. 4:6 have significance? And, is Sabbath in Eden the same as the one given to Israelites & us today? Was it written or implied to keep the Sabbath at creation? 

3.     Is it okay to pray while burning incense, lighting candles, or even using anointing olive oil for the sick? Why don't Adventists do it yet it's biblical? 

4.  We've had two questions submitted about the duration of the 7 last plagues. Revelation 18:8 mentions plagues coming "in One Day". Is this based on a prophetic day for a year principle referenced in Ezekiel 4:6?  How long will the plagues last? How long will the seven last plagues last?  

5.  How can we understand such strong malice towards the enemy in some of the Psalms like 69, 83, and 109? It doesn't sound Christ-like. Why is there such strong malice in Psalms 69, 83, and 109? 

6.  If we are going to be changed in a twinkling of an eye, why couldn't we go straight to Heaven when we die? Why can't we go straight to Heaven when we die? 

7.  How old is the world exactly and if this world was given 6000 years then how far are we from the coming of Christ? 

8.  How do I begin to study the Bible? 

9.  Where in the Bible does it state that Hell is not eternal?  

10. Why does it say in 1 Corinthians 5:8 to keep the feasts but we say the feasts are done away with at the cross? Biblical references, please. Is the keeping of the feasts in 1 Corinthians 5:8 done away with? 

11.  Can you please explain Romans 7:1-3? 

12.  Are there really mansions in Heaven or is that figurative?
